name: yapper
label: Yapper - vertical podcast monologue
description: Vertical talking-head podcast clips with native generated dialogue first, then optional voice change if the native voice is not the cast voice.

promptOverrides.video:
A fast-paced medium close-up video of the speaker from the provided image.
From the very first frame the speaker looks directly into the lens and is
already speaking {pace}. Their lips move energetically to deliver this
{language} dialogue: "{dialogue}". They perform with {performance}. Immediately
after the final word they settle into {ending}. Keep the podcast studio
background, wardrobe, and vertical framing from the start frame steady throughout.

slotDefaults.pace: rapidly and continuously with zero pauses
slotDefaults.performance: sharp, subtle head shakes and expressive podcast-host facial micro-expressions

video.postprocess: Review the native generated voice. If the mouth timing works but the voice does not match the cast voice, run voice_change_video instead of regenerating TTS first.
